target_pages.rule: authentic need controls total; no padding

planned_documents.structure: case summary, proposed charges, communication and access chronology
planned_documents.purpose: neutral allegation, statutory-version and attribution map

planned_documents.structure: complainant/household/provider statements and original-message exhibit register
planned_documents.purpose: receipt, impact, device access and source context

planned_documents.structure: device seizure, forensic image/acquisition, hash manifest and examination report
planned_documents.purpose: native continuity, scope, recovered/deleted artefacts and limits

planned_documents.structure: native-like platform JSON, schema/data dictionary and human-readable render
planned_documents.purpose: schema, event, message and account provenance

planned_documents.structure: EML/MSG messages, header/attachment/forward-chain register and render
planned_documents.purpose: email source, transport and content attribution

planned_documents.structure: CSV login/session/IP/subscriber schedules and platform returns
planned_documents.purpose: time, network, account and device correlation without author inference

planned_documents.structure: audio/video masters, clips, transcript and metadata register
planned_documents.purpose: media lineage, speaker and event-attribution limits

planned_documents.structure: interview, defence statement and competing digital-expert reports/addenda
planned_documents.purpose: party positions, methods, limitations and opinion changes

planned_documents.structure: disclosure schedules, applications/rulings, hearing/deadline and trial-preparation records
planned_documents.purpose: service, admissibility, late return and procedural provenance

boundary: Valid evidential files only. Malicious uploads, corrupt/polyglot files, archive abuse and parser attacks remain the separate security harness.
